description.en: MVL-SIB is a multilingual dataset that provides image-sentence pairs spanning 205 languages and 7 topical categories (entertainment, geography, health, politics, science, sports, travel). It was constructed by extending the SIB-200 benchmark.
description.zh: MVL-SIB 是一个多语言数据集，提供了涵盖 205 种语言和 7 个主题类别的图像-句子对（ entertainment ， geography ， health ， politics ， science ， sports ， travel ）。它通过扩展 SIB-200 基准构建而成。
